runtime.installation: prebuilt PyPI wheel in isolated venv; wheel version matches pinned source pyproject version; not compiled from Git commit (Cargo/Rust toolchain absent)

smoke_backtest.source: deterministic locally generated synthetic prices; no download

upstream_quickstart.data: synthetic random walk, no network or download

screenshots.notes: GitHub source plus official docs; output screenshots show evaluator harness rather than native application UI

limits: No real market data, account, broker adapter, Testnet or Live lifecycle.
The custom 4,000-bar sample does not include an explicit commission/slippage model; its synthetic PnL is not evidence of strategy quality.
Full repository test suite was not run; package was smoke-tested via its official quickstart and a deterministic local backtest.
Release-candidate wheel version was used; the exact pinned Git commit was not built from source.
